changelog: EXPLOSIONS LAND PROPERLY. The smoke plays across a blast's whole footprint -- every tile inside the radius, not just the ones that took damage -- so shelling empty ground looks like an explosion rather than a single puff, and it runs at a readable speed instead of flickering past. Everything since 0.0.70 is included: the bosses' new dialogue (an opening line before their first move, reactions as you wound them, remarks when you kill their troops), the new Warlord card frame, and card-to-card navigation in the zoomed view.
